## Modules

- Pipeline
  - [Membrane.Pipeline](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Pipeline.md): A behaviour module for implementing pipelines.
  - [Membrane.Pipeline.Action](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Pipeline.Action.md): This module contains type specifications of actions that can be returned
from pipeline callbacks.
  - [Membrane.Pipeline.CallbackContext](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Pipeline.CallbackContext.md): Module describing context passed to the `Membrane.Pipeline` callbacks.

- RC Pipeline
  - [Membrane.RCMessage](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.RCMessage.md): An abstract module aggregating all the messages that can be sent by the `RCPipeline`.
  - [Membrane.RCPipeline](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.RCPipeline.md): Remote controlled pipeline - a basic `Membrane.Pipeline` implementation that can be remotely controlled from an external process.
  - [Membrane.RCMessage.EndOfStream](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.RCMessage.EndOfStream.md): Message sent when some element of the pipeline receives the start of stream event on some pad.

  - [Membrane.RCMessage.Notification](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.RCMessage.Notification.md): Message sent when the some element of the pipeline receives a notification.

  - [Membrane.RCMessage.Playing](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.RCMessage.Playing.md): Message sent when the pipeline starts playing

  - [Membrane.RCMessage.StartOfStream](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.RCMessage.StartOfStream.md): Message sent when some element of the pipeline receives the start of stream event on some pad.

  - [Membrane.RCMessage.Terminated](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.RCMessage.Terminated.md): Message sent when the pipeline gracefully terminates.

- Bin
  - [Membrane.Bin](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Bin.md): Bins, similarly to pipelines, are containers for elements.
However, at the same time, they can be placed and linked within pipelines.
Although bin is a separate Membrane entity, it can be perceived as a pipeline within an element.
Bins can also be nested within one another.
  - [Membrane.Bin.Action](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Bin.Action.md): This module contains type specifications of actions that can be returned
from bin callbacks.
  - [Membrane.Bin.CallbackContext](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Bin.CallbackContext.md): Module describing context passed to the `Membrane.Bin` callbacks.

  - [Membrane.Bin.PadData](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Bin.PadData.md): Struct describing current pad state.

- Element
  - [Membrane.Element](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Element.md): Module containing types and functions for operating on elements.
  - [Membrane.Endpoint](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Endpoint.md): Module defining behaviour for endpoints - elements consuming and producing data.
  - [Membrane.Filter](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Filter.md): Module defining behaviour for filters - elements processing data.
  - [Membrane.Sink](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Sink.md): Module defining behaviour for sinks - elements consuming data.
  - [Membrane.Source](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Source.md): Module that should be used in sources - elements producing data. Declares
appropriate behaviours implementation and provides default callbacks implementation.
  - [Membrane.Element.Action](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Element.Action.md): This module contains type specifications of actions that can be returned
from element callbacks.
  - [Membrane.Element.Base](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Element.Base.md): Module defining behaviour common to all elements.
  - [Membrane.Element.CallbackContext](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Element.CallbackContext.md): Describes context passed to the Membrane Element callbacks.

  - [Membrane.Element.PadData](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Element.PadData.md): Struct describing current pad state.
  - [Membrane.Element.WithInputPads](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Element.WithInputPads.md): Module defining behaviour for sink, filter and endpoint elements.
  - [Membrane.Element.WithOutputPads](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Element.WithOutputPads.md): Module defining behaviour for source and filter elements.

- Helper Elements
  - [Membrane.Connector](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Connector.md): Membrane Filter with input and output dynamic pads, that forwards incoming data to the opposite
side than the one from which it came.
  - [Membrane.Debug.Filter](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Debug.Filter.md): Membrane Filter, that can be used to create a child that will be used to debug data flowing thouth pipeline.
  - [Membrane.Debug.Sink](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Debug.Sink.md): Membrane Sink, that can be used to create a child that will be used to debug data flowing thouth pipeline.
  - [Membrane.Fake.Sink](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Fake.Sink.md): Membrane Sink that ignores incoming data.
  - [Membrane.FilterAggregator](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.FilterAggregator.md): An element allowing to aggregate many filters within one Elixir process.
  - [Membrane.Funnel](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Funnel.md): Element that can be used for collecting data from multiple inputs and sending it through one
output.
  - [Membrane.Funnel.NewInputEvent](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Funnel.NewInputEvent.md): Event sent each time new element is linked (via funnel input pad) after playing pipeline.

  - [Membrane.Tee](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Tee.md): Element for forwarding buffers to at least one output pad

- Parent
  - [Membrane.ChildrenSpec](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.ChildrenSpec.md): A module with functionalities that allow to represent a topology of a pipeline/bin.

- Child
  - [Membrane.Child](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Child.md): Module that keeps track of types used by both elements and bins

  - [Membrane.ChildEntry](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.ChildEntry.md): Struct describing child entry of a parent.

- Communication
  - [Membrane.Buffer](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Buffer.md): Structure representing a single chunk of data that flows between elements.
  - [Membrane.ChildNotification](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.ChildNotification.md): A child notification is a message sent from `Membrane.Element` or `Membrane.Bin` to a parent
via action `t:Membrane.Element.Action.notify_parent` or `t:Membrane.Bin.Action.notify_parent`
returned from any callback.
  - [Membrane.Event](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Event.md): Represents a communication event, capable of flowing both downstream and upstream.
  - [Membrane.EventProtocol](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.EventProtocol.md): Protocol that allows to configure behaviour of `Membrane.Event`s.
  - [Membrane.KeyframeRequestEvent](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.KeyframeRequestEvent.md): Generic event for requesting a key frame.
  - [Membrane.Pad](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Pad.md): Pads are units defined by elements and bins, allowing them to be linked with their
siblings. This module consists of pads typespecs and utils.
  - [Membrane.ParentNotification](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.ParentNotification.md): A parent notification is a message sent from `Membrane.Parent` or `Membrane.Bin` to a child
via action `t:Membrane.Pipeline.Action.notify_parent` or `t:Membrane.Bin.Action.notify_child`
returned from any callback.
  - [Membrane.Payload](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Payload.md): This protocol describes actions common to all payload types.
  - [Membrane.RemoteStream](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.RemoteStream.md): Format describing an unparsed data stream. It should be used whenever outputting
or accepting an unknown stream (not to be confused with _any_ stream, which
can have well-specified format either), or a stream whose format can't/shouldn't
be created at that stage.
  - [Membrane.StreamFormat](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.StreamFormat.md): Defines the capabilities of a pad within the Membrane framework.
  - [Membrane.Buffer.Metric](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Buffer.Metric.md): Specifies the type for demand units.
  - [Membrane.Buffer.Metric.ByteSize](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Buffer.Metric.ByteSize.md): Implementation of `Membrane.Buffer.Metric` for the `:bytes` unit.
  - [Membrane.Buffer.Metric.Count](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Buffer.Metric.Count.md): Implementation of `Membrane.Buffer.Metric` for the `:buffers` unit.
  - [Membrane.Event.Discontinuity](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Event.Discontinuity.md): Generic discontinuity event.
  - [Membrane.Event.Underrun](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Event.Underrun.md): Generic underrun event.
  - [Membrane.EventProtocol.DefaultImpl](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.EventProtocol.DefaultImpl.md): Default implementation of `Membrane.EventProtocol`.
  - [Membrane.Payload.Behaviour](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Payload.Behaviour.md): Behaviour that should be implemented by every module that has
`Membrane.Payload` protocol implementation.

  - [Membrane.Payload.Binary](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Payload.Binary.md): `Membrane.Payload.Behaviour` implementation for binary payload.
Complements `Membrane.Payload` protocol implementation.

- Logging
  - [Membrane.Logger](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Logger.md): Wrapper around the Elixir logger. Adds Membrane prefixes and handles verbose logging.

- Telemetry
  - [Membrane.Telemetry](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Telemetry.md): Defines basic telemetry event types used by Membrane's Core.

- Testing
  - [Membrane.Testing.Assertions](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Testing.Assertions.md): This module contains a set of assertion functions and macros.
  - [Membrane.Testing.DynamicSource](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Testing.DynamicSource.md): Testing Element for supplying data based on generator function or payloads passed
through options. It is very similar to `Membrane.Testing.Source` but is has dynamic
pad instead of static.
  - [Membrane.Testing.Endpoint](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Testing.Endpoint.md)
  - [Membrane.Testing.Event](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Testing.Event.md): Empty event that can be used in tests

  - [Membrane.Testing.MockResourceGuard](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Testing.MockResourceGuard.md): Mock for `Membrane.ResourceGuard`.
  - [Membrane.Testing.Pipeline](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Testing.Pipeline.md): This Pipeline was created to reduce testing boilerplate and ease communication
with its children. It also provides a utility for informing testing process about
playback changes and received notifications.
  - [Membrane.Testing.Sink](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Testing.Sink.md): Sink Element that notifies the pipeline about buffers and events it receives.
  - [Membrane.Testing.Source](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Testing.Source.md): Testing Element for supplying data based on generator function or payloads passed
through options.

- Utils
  - [Membrane.Clock](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Clock.md): Clock is a Membrane utility that allows elements to measure time according to
a particular clock, which can be e.g. a soundcard hardware clock.
  - [Membrane.ComponentPath](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.ComponentPath.md): A list consisting of following pipeline/bin/element names down the assembled pipeline.
  - [Membrane.Playback](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Playback.md): Playback defines whether media is processed within a pipeline (`:playing`) or not (`:stopped`).
  - [Membrane.ResourceGuard](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.ResourceGuard.md): Utility for handling resources that must be cleaned up after use.
  - [Membrane.Sync](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Sync.md): Sync allows to synchronize multiple processes, so that they could perform their
jobs at the same time.
  - [Membrane.Time](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Time.md): Module containing functions needed to perform handling of time.
  - [Membrane.UtilitySupervisor](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.UtilitySupervisor.md): A supervisor responsible for managing utility processes under the pipeline's
supervision tree.

- Errors
  - [Membrane.ActionError](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.ActionError.md)
  - [Membrane.BinError](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.BinError.md)
  - [Membrane.CallbackError](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.CallbackError.md)
  - [Membrane.ElementError](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.ElementError.md)
  - [Membrane.LinkError](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.LinkError.md)
  - [Membrane.PadDirectionError](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.PadDirectionError.md)
  - [Membrane.PadError](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.PadError.md)
  - [Membrane.ParentError](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.ParentError.md)
  - [Membrane.PipelineError](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.PipelineError.md)
  - [Membrane.SetupError](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.SetupError.md)
  - [Membrane.StreamFormatError](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.StreamFormatError.md)
  - [Membrane.TimerError](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.TimerError.md)
  - [Membrane.UnknownChildError](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.UnknownChildError.md)
  - [Membrane.UnknownPadError](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.UnknownPadError.md)

## Mix Tasks

- [mix membrane.demo](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Membrane.Demo.md): Download Membrane demos and examples. Requires `git` installed.
- [mix membrane.gen](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Membrane.Gen.md): Lists all available Membrane component generators
- [mix membrane.gen.bin](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Membrane.Gen.Bin.md): Generates a template for a Membrane Bin with the provided module name.
- [mix membrane.gen.endpoint](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Membrane.Gen.Endpoint.md): Generates a template for a Membrane Endpoint with the provided module name.
- [mix membrane.gen.filter](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Membrane.Gen.Filter.md): Generates a template for a Membrane Filter with the provided module name.
- [mix membrane.gen.pipeline](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Membrane.Gen.Pipeline.md): Generates a template for a Membrane Pipeline with the provided module name.
- [mix membrane.gen.sink](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Membrane.Gen.Sink.md): Generates a template for a Membrane Sink with the provided module name.
- [mix membrane.gen.source](https://membrane-core.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Membrane.Gen.Source.md): Generates a template for a Membrane Source with the provided module name.
